reply.text:
I can't give you a green light on that combination, and I won't put an amount on pre-workout or anything else in it. Pre-workouts are usually built around stimulants, and alcohol is a different kind of drug. Mixing them is the sort of thing that's worth asking a doctor or pharmacist about, especially if you take any medication or have a heart or blood pressure history.

On the training side, alcohol close to a session tends to hurt it. It cuts into sleep, recovery and hydration, so the next day's lifting usually pays for it. If you're training, I'd keep the two apart. And if you want a plan built around your week, I can set that up.
